text:
zara-growth: Quick heads up — marketing is greenlighting a new "Pro Plus" pricing bucket that goes live tomorrow morning. It raises per-account token throttle from 2k -> 10k/min and increases default quotas. Need a quick infra estimate: GPU-hour uplift, regional pressure, and whether we should pre-reserve Dedicated capacity. cc @tom-capacity @maya-engineer

 tom-capacity: Do we have expected signup shapes? spike vs gradual matters a lot for reserve decisions.

 zara-growth: Short plan from growth: 1k paid opt-ins in the first 48h (front-loaded), ~5k within 30 days if conversion holds. They want a 7-day and 30-day capacity ask for finance.

 maya-engineer: Baseline numbers to use: hosted traffic ~12k active API clients, platform avg ~620 GPU-hours/day. Region split: US ~65%, EU ~25%, APAC ~10%. Current spare capacity: ~18 GPUs across all regions (hot spare). KV/prefix cache reduces work ~25-35% for repeat prompts.

 dean-infra: Back-of-envelope projections (very rough): conservative +40% GPU-hours, base-case +100%, aggressive +250-300% if bursty + long contexts + lots of 70B model usage. Biggest levers: model family mix, avg tokens per call, cache hit rate.

 dean-infra: FWIW quick calc I ran for 1k concurrent ProPlus users (initial push):
 ```
 # rough capacity calc
 active_proplus = 1000  # concurrent active users for initial window
 avg_reqs_per_min = 1  # ~1 generation/min per active user
 tokens_per_req = 150
 tokens_per_min = active_proplus * avg_reqs_per_min * tokens_per_req  # 150k tokens/min
 tokens_per_hour = tokens_per_min * 60  # 9,000,000 tokens/hour
 tokens_per_gpu_hour = 5_000_000  # rough tokens a typical GPU can serve per hour (varies by model/seq)
 gpu_hours_per_hour = tokens_per_hour / tokens_per_gpu_hour  # ~1.8 GPU needed continuously
 gpu_hours_day = gpu_hours_per_hour * 24  # ~43 GPU-hours/day for this cohort
 ```
 scale that by number of parallel cohorts and model mix. If customers use larger context lengths or 70B models, per-token throughput drops -> multiply by 2-3x.

 zara-growth: So if initial 1k -> ~40-100 GPU-hours/day depending on mix. That sounds smaller than I expected vs marketing's ask — is that right?

 maya-engineer: Numbers are in the right ballpark for inference-only generations. But remember: interactive chat workloads (frequent short messages) + streaming increases per-req overhead (latency SLOs push us to more pinned concurrency). Also bursty signups can create short windows where we need 10x baseline for <12h.

 ops-bot: Autoscaler snapshot: free vGPUs = {"us-west-2": 10, "eu-west-1": 3, "ap-south-1": 0}. Daily GPU-hours current = 620. Spot reclaim window = 15m.

 dean-infra: Regional constraints: EU has low spare capacity — if marketing's EU-heavy signups happen, we'll either shift traffic to multi-region routing (higher latency) or pre-warm eu-west pools. APAC is fragile (0 spare) and should be explicitly throttled or routed to us-west depending on LATENCY vs SLO conversation.

 tom-capacity: Options on the table: 1) reserve short-term Dedicated pool in us-west + eu-west (cost but predictable), 2) set a progressive rollout + soft quota increases (ramp on signups), 3) enable automatic fallback to smaller model family for Pro Plus when capacity high, 4) temporary per-account hard throttles/queued requests.

 maya-engineer: Quick rough cost impact: if we assume base-case +100% -> +620 GPU-hours/day -> ~18,600 GPU-hours/month. If avg cost/GPU-hour = $3 (varies by instance/spot), that's ~55k/month incremental. These are ballpark — exact depends on instance mix and reserved vs spot ratio.

 zara-growth: Okay need a crisp recommendation for finance: 7-day ask and 30-day ask with cost delta and risk notes. Prefer minimal friction for marketing but they understand gating if infra asks for reserves.

 dean-infra: Proposed: 7-day: enable progressive rollout capped at 30% of signups + reserve 40 GPUs in us-west and 8 in eu-west for 7 days. 30-day: increase to 120 GPUs reserved across regions with review at day 14. Also enable fallback-to-7B policy for >90th percentile load.

 tom-capacity: I'll produce a 7-day reserve plan + Terraform cost delta and a 30-day scenario by EOD. Maya will run a staging replay for the expected ProPlus profile to validate autoscaler behavior. Dean will sync with sales on Dedicated upsell language.

 maya-engineer: I'll also run two sims: (a) optimistic cache hit 35% and model mix favoring 7B, (b) pessimistic 10% cache hit + 70B heavy — get numbers within 12h.

 zara-growth: Thanks — please post final numbers in this thread. If any immediate blockers (eu spare = 3) escalate to leadership for pre-approval. :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

 ops-bot: Reminder: create a dedicated incident channel if you're coordinating a pre-warm/reserve action (use #incidents).
